changelog:
Initial release—enables red team self-attack and automated robustness evaluation for intelligent agents.

- Generates adversarial probes from known attack templates to evaluate policies before/after deployment.
- Quantifies robustness score and identifies policy blind spots and over-refusals.
- Provides a core API for automated probe generation and evaluation using only the Python standard library.
- Outputs detailed lists of flip (policy evasion) and blind spot cases for secure policy iteration.
- Designed for meta-evolution loops: helps trigger self-repair and track evolving attack patterns.
summary: 红队自我攻防：给定目标策略，从已知攻击模板（提示注入/jailbreak角色扮演/编码混淆/ OOD/歧义）生成对抗探针，每条带红队 ground-truth，跑目标策略统计翻转率与盲区，输出 鲁棒分与盲区清单。让智能体主动生成对抗样本、自己测自己、自己暴露盲区——一线大模型 不具备的元治理能力，是"可靠地超越"的安全收口层。
